# Briefing preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Daily brief:** 06:30 CT, before the floor gets going. Lead with any **safety** event in the
  last 24h, then OTD/production misses by plant, then the day's decisions and meetings.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly preview:** Sunday evening — the week's board/lender/customer commitments and any
  slipping projects.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly retro:** Friday — OEE and scrap by plant vs. target, OTD, and open commitments aging.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Always flag:** anything touching the [First Meridian covenant](../projects/refinancing.md),
  a safety recordable, or [Slate](../projects/slate.md) (confidential — code name only).
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Standing rule:** if a commitment is **overdue**, surface it at the top of the daily brief.
